text:
samir: Heads up — private deploy in eu-west reported ~10% request errors after an automated KMS key rotation yesterday. Error looks like `KMS: access denied` in logs. Anyone oncall?

maya: Cc @taylor_sec. Logs?

samir: pasted logs snippet:
```
ERR: 2024-11-03T04:22:11Z modelserv: token decrypt failed: access denied for key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123:key/abcd-ef - principal "redwood-service"
```
Also RBAC audit shows role `redwood-inference-node` lost kms:Decrypt permission.

taylor_sec: Did the rotation create new key alias and remove grants? Could be missing key policy grant for the service principal. I'm pulling cloudtrail.

elin: Also seeing increased 502s at the edge; netpol denies egress to KMS endpoint when running in VPC with restrictive egress. Maybe combined effect.

samir: Sequence: 1) KMS rotation triggered by ops (automated), 2) node pool restarted gradually, 3) errors spike. Hypothesis: grant not reissued + netpol tight.

taylor_sec: Action items: 1) temporary rollback to previous key alias, 2) re-apply grant via sts assume-role on nodes (runbook step 3), 3) open an incident page. I'll open the runbook.

taylor_sec: Runbook snippet to re-grant: 
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/redwood-inference-key --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123:role/redwood-inference-node --operations Decrypt,Encrypt --name grant-temp
```

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook created: https://r.redwood/runbooks/kms-rotation-emergency — incident #INC-2024-1123

carter: Netpolicy config: we added egress `allow: kms.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com:443` but some nodes in private subnet use NAT with different IPs. Could be IP mismatch with egress whitelist.

maya: Quick mitigation: scale up dedicated pool in another region (eu-central) as fallback and route traffic there. Need to toggle smart-routing: `policy.cascade.fallback = true`

samir: Rolling back key worked for a portion of traffic. Will keep monitoring. Need follow-up: update RBAC automation to apply grants on rotation and add audit alert when KMS Decrypt returns AccessDenied.

taylor_sec: Opened ticket to add audit rule: `k8s.audit.rule: 'kms:Decrypt access_denied' => pagerduty`. Also add netpol test: CI will run a `curl` to KMS endpoint via nat IP to ensure egress allowed.

elin: :thumbsup: Also recommend documenting the 'rotation cascade' in Private Deploy checklist and add canary: don't rotate primary key until grants propagated.

carter: Vuln triage note: key rotation itself fine. The vulnerability was lack of automation for re-grants + netpol assumptions. Marking low-sev but requires immediate infra fix.

samir: Closing incident in 2 hours if no regressions. Recording timeline in incident doc.
